summary: Recent updates to the Media Sink area of Firefox have improved how the browser handles audio playback, particularly on macOS. The audio sink now starts asynchronously when resuming playback after a seek, which enhances responsiveness and decreases lag during user interactions. Additionally, the AudioSinkWrapper has been optimized to wait for initialization tasks to finish before shutting down, making the shutdown process smoother. Improvements in arithmetic checks for audio processing ensure more reliable playback without buffer overruns or underruns. Overall, these enhancements contribute to a more efficient and seamless audio experience for users while listening to media.
